findings.text: the operator-facing agent receipts verb passes neither probe nor compaction_paths, so the node sections and the tier compaction are reachable only from the module's own CLI -- a receipts run started from the documented verb writes no card, host or job section and never compacts, with no flag to opt in, and the wiring is therefore single-entry in production.

main() constructs NodeProbe by default, so every serve sidecar pays three subprocess reads per five-second tick while the only bound on that cost -- the plan's under-one-percent-of-one-core, measured on the node -- is unmeasured, because no serve has yet written a row from a GPU node; the first real serve is the instrument and --no-node-probe is the lever already present.
